description: Rig objects with armatures and animate actions and keyframes.

identity.goal: Complete the rig animate use case of blender using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the blender upstream of the blender-connector connector. The namespace `blender` is active by default; if the operator set lazy activation, activate it with registry_activate first. Every tool below is namespaced blender_<tool>. Call `handshake` first and stop with a recovery report when it is not ready. Save the .blend file before running code. Use this when: Creating an armature, parenting a mesh to bones, posing, setting keyframes or an action, or changing the frame range. Do not use it for: Static scene layout (use blender-build-scene) or reviewing the motion only (use blender-review-viewport with frames). Tools: `blender_execute_blender_code`, `blender_get_scene_info`, `blender_look`. Steps, each with one objective and a check you must pass before the next: (1) Build the armature and parent the mesh to it. Call `blender_execute_blender_code`. Check: The printed bone list is not empty and the mesh's parent is the armature. (2) Pose the rig and keyframe the action. Call `blender_execute_blender_code`. Check: The printed action name exists and the frame range covers your keyframes. (3) Check rig health, and afterwards the motion with a strip of frames. Call `blender_get_scene_info`. Check: No deform bones without vertices and no vertices without a deform bone. (4) Look at several frames. Call `blender_look`. Check: The strip shows the motion progressing across the frame range. On failure follow the recovery table of the skill `blender-rig-animate`; report a refusal payload when a tool refuses and never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the blender namespace was available and handshake was ready before the first tool call
every step's check passed before the next step ran
every tool named in this prompt exists in the upstream snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
